Luke, I’ll commit to 12 tons this month if all five of us agree before choosing. Emma, I support your stock-dependent limits and rotating extra whole-ton shares, but I’d prefer this larger reserve over leaving just 5 tons.

Since our choices are simultaneous, none of us can wait to see what the others catch. Let’s get explicit commitments now, then check the revealed catches and actual stock before agreeing on next month’s limits. Kate, would you accept 12 tons each?
